# eventsRequired

<!-- @constructive-io/graphql-codegen - DO NOT EDIT -->

Reads and enables pagination through a set of `AppLevelRequirement`.

## Usage

```typescript
useEventsRequiredQuery({ after: '<Cursor>', first: '<Int>', level: '<String>', offset: '<Int>', roleId: '<UUID>' })
```

## Examples

### Use useEventsRequiredQuery

```typescript
const { data, isLoading } = useEventsRequiredQuery({ after: '<Cursor>', first: '<Int>', level: '<String>', offset: '<Int>', roleId: '<UUID>' });
```
